subhead: Make your own MLB Showdown card sets, then share them with everyone.

features.title: Build your own set
features.text: Design a full Showdown set from start to finish. Start from a classic 2000–2005 base set, or from scratch.

features.title: Smart player picks
features.text: Pick the seasons, size and teams, and the bot builds a balanced set. Or pick your own.

features.title: See how it stacks up
features.text: Charts compare points, positions, speed and more against the original WOTC sets.

features.title: Style every card
features.text: One look for the whole set, special looks for groups of cards, and new parallels.

features.title: Render every card
features.text: Every card renders while you keep working. Download the whole set at once.

features.title: Publish and share
features.text: Share with everyone, by link only, or keep it to yourself. Links show a preview of your set.

features.title: Remix, like, comment
features.text: Start your own set from someone else's, save your favorites, and talk shop in the comments.

features.title: A whole new look
features.text: Showdown Bot's redesign takes its cues from the original late-90s cards.
